test_overview: Evaluated advanced Browse filtering functionality of the marketplace app against the 6-step test plan. The server was accessible at http://localhost:8000 and all test steps executed successfully. Step 1: Created all 5 products via the create-listing flow, each showing a '✅ Listing Created!' success confirmation with a unique seller link; verified on /browse ('5 items found'). Step 2: In default filter state, all 5 products were visible. Step 3: Multi-select filters (Electronics OR Books) AND (new OR good) correctly showed Gaming Laptop, Used Laptop, Hardcover Novel while excluding Designer Handbag and Garden Tools Set. Step 4: Adding price range $50-$1000 with existing filters correctly narrowed results to only Used Laptop. Step 5: Selecting only 'Vehicles' produced the empty state with 'No products match your search', result count '0 items found', and both filter-panel and empty-state Reset Filters controls; clicking Reset restored all 5 products. Step 6: Price range min=$500.00/max=$900.00 demonstrated inclusive bounds (Used Laptop $500.00 and Designer Handbag $900.00 both shown). All 6 steps passed, total 37/37 points.

steps.description: setup_create_five_products - Created all 5 products via create-listing flow with required fields (title, description, price, category, condition, location, product image, seller name, seller email). Each creation showed a success confirmation with a unique seller link. Verified on /browse that '5 items found' and all 5 titles present.

test_all_products_visible_default - On /browse in default filter state, all 5 products are visible (no pagination needed). Filter chips for categories/conditions are unselected by default (equivalent to 'All' per PRD), price inputs empty.

test_multi_select_category_and_condition - Multi-select category (Electronics+Books) and condition (new+good) filters applied via chips. Correct (Electronics OR Books) AND (new OR good) logic: showed Gaming Laptop, Used Laptop, Hardcover Novel; excluded Designer Handbag and Garden Tools Set; '3 items found'.

test_price_range_combined_with_filters - With previous filters retained, set price min=$50/max=$1000 and clicked Apply. Only Used Laptop ($500.00) shown; Gaming Laptop ($1500.00 above max) and Hardcover Novel ($20.00 below min) excluded; '1 item found'. Combined AND logic across category+condition+price correct.

test_empty_result_and_reset - Reset filters to default, then selected only Vehicles category (all others unchecked). Empty state shown: '0 items found', 'No products match your search' message, and a Reset Filters control available (filter panel and empty state). Clicking Reset returned to /browse with all 5 products visible again.

test_price_range_inclusive_bounds - With default filters, set min=$500.00/max=$900.00 and Apply. Used Laptop ($500.00, matches min) and Designer Handbag ($900.00, matches max) both shown proving inclusive boundaries. Gaming Laptop ($1500.00), Garden Tools Set ($30.00), Hardcover Novel ($20.00) all excluded; '2 items found'.
